If the account is in pending_profile status (first sign-in) and display_name is provided, it is atomically transitioned to active. All fields are optional; omit a field to leave it unchanged. delete.description: Removes a push token. Idempotent — returns 204 even if the token did not exist. Call on logout or when expo-notifications fires a DeviceNotRegistered event.
